atoms.b: I left school early ((because)) I had a doctor’s appointment.

atoms.b: However, ((because)) I forgot my backpack, we had to turn around and we were late.

atoms.a: I had to go to the doctor’s because my throat hurt.

atoms.a: The doctor told me I had tonsillitis because of a virus.
atoms.b: The doctor told me I had tonsillitis ((because)) of a virus.

atoms.a: I stayed at home for two days because I was ill.
atoms.b: I stayed at home for two days ((because)) I was ill.
